latest_commit.subject: hub 1.17.0: collapsible session reports (HUBR-325) + empty-events dead end fixed (HUBR-326)
latest_commit.body:
Owner asks, both deployed and live-verified.

HUBR-325: the Session Reports list is collapsed by default behind a
<details> whose summary counts session reports and total files. It had
reached 85 session reports / 340 files on the bench device once
HUBR-324 started generating a report for every session ending.

HUBR-326: the device page could render "68456 events in total" and
NOTHING else - no table, no navigation. Reproduced live: with
order=DESC the list filter is events.id < events_after, and the
Next-page link passes the smallest id on the page, so paging to the end
(or any stale/bookmarked small cursor) selects zero rows while the
count query still returns the full total (events_after=1 and =500 both
gave 0 rows). The branch now states the cursor is past the end, echoes
its value, and links back to the newest events. This is NOT an
event-count or 16-bit limit: event ids are ~16.7M and the underlying
query returns 200 rows correctly.

Verified by an offline full-template render of both branches BEFORE
deploy - which caught a first draft using a non-existent Jinja 'search'
test that would have 500'd the page - then live on the hub.

Hub registry DOC 1.19; doc regenerated; source archived with deploy and
rollback instructions in development/hub_1.17.0/.
